# SILK C SDK source subset

This directory retains only the unmodified SDK C sources and headers compiled by
`adapters/windows-rs/build.rs`, together with the original distribution license.
The unused Python package, extension wrappers and packaging metadata were removed.

The complete unmodified pilk 0.2.4 distribution remains available in
`thirdparty-sources/pilk-0.2.4.tar.gz` for source provenance and license compliance.
Each SDK source file retains its original Skype Limited copyright and terms.
